truth: This is a frozen catalogue source. It is not represented as a replay of the complete Preview migration history.
why: The promotion set was compiled from a LIVE Preview catalogue. That stopped being defensible when Preview received 202608050002, a runtime-only overlay that gives it the post-P111 erasure authority: live Preview became a RUNTIME TARGET, not a compiler source. The compiler noticed on its own and began refusing a live-Preview catalogue. Replay is not an option either — the checked-in Preview lineage is not linearly replayable (202607270002 is a compensating rollback whose tables 202607270003 then alters, and 202607280004 collides with the baseline recommendation_graph shape). So the source is FROZEN, and its authority rests on mechanical regeneration rather than on provenance narrative.
